item.title: GST Relief for Waste Management: Kerala AAR Confirms GST Exemption Under Entry 3B
item.description: Kerala AAR confirms that the solid waste management services provided to Clean Kerala Company Ltd. are fully exempt from GST under Entry 3B.

item.title: Kerala High Court Extends SVLDRS Payment Benefit by Applying Supreme Court’s COVID Limitation Orders
item.description: HC rules that SVLDRS proceedings are quasi-judicial; payment made after deadline but within SC’s COVID extension is valid. Recovery proceedings quashed

item.title: DCF valuation certificate by Chartered Accountant held wrong and defective by ITAT: ICAI Technical Guide on Share Valuation not considered
item.description: Income Tax Tribunal finds Chartered Accountant’s DCF valuation unsupportive and unrealistic; NAV-based valuation adopted by AO sustained

item.title: Goods intercepted for not updating e-way bill: HC Quashes Order, gives opportunity for Fresh Hearing
item.description: The High Court observed that the lower authority had failed to consider the explanation for the delay submitted by the petitioner.

item.title: New ITR Forms to Be Released Early for FY 2025-26: What Taxpayers Should Know
item.description: The Income Tax Department will release the new, simplified ITR forms by January 2026 to give everyone enough preparation time.

item.title: GST ITC can be availed on amount spent from Government grant: AAR
item.description: Kerala AAR rules that KASE must pay GST on fees collected from its skill training partners and students. The organisation can however avail ITC on the same.

item.title: No GST Exemption on Services given to society funded/controlled by State Government: AAR
item.description: Kerala AAR reviewed ICTAK’s claim for GST exemption on services to K-DISC and clarified the treatment of ITC on subcontracted services.

item.title: GSTN Issues New Advisory on Mandatory Bank Account Submission Under Rule 10A
item.description: GSTN has issued a new advisory making it mandatory for taxpayers to submit their bank account details under Rule 10A, with strict consequences.

item.title: 5% GST Applicable on Construction of Landowner’s Share of Residential Flats: AAR
item.description: The applicable GST rate is 5% (2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST) without ITC on constructional services for residential apartments (other than the affordable units), as per Notification No. 03/2019 dated 29.03.2019
